description: Ticket exists but records 3 hours (not longer than 4), so Rule 3 does not qualify and the request falls to Rule 2. The customer's 'most of the afternoon' must not override the ticket.

turns.note: Rule 3 fallback clause: outage <= 4 hours -> evaluate under Rule 2 with the $75.00 ceiling. Policy gives no amount formula for this, so answer or escalate are both defensible. Clarify is not: the date and start time are given and KB-1005 steps 1-2 look the ticket up from approximate dates; the ticket, not the customer, supplies the duration.
